effective_scope: New graph-base/1.3.0 runtime0.5.0 Vector15 optimize-only hardware campaign; no historical run is reinterpreted.
activation_status: Writing or validating this policy dispatches no experiment. Freeze before the first seed.
deadline_rule: Targets only warn/checkpoint; preserve one continuous task clock including both rounds and waits; real errors/cancellation still apply.

triggers: absolute speedup distance from applicable gate<=0.005
retest_policy.selection_rule: If triggered, the second complete valid capture is authoritative regardless of direction. Keep the first. If repeat is invalid/missing, report inconclusive; do not select the favorable first capture.
retest_policy.expired_parent_refresh: Declare before collection, retain all captures and costs; refresh is not a new optimization attempt and cannot select faster A.
retest_policy.final_comparison: Declare direct original-R0 versus selected implementation before candidates. Reuse an already valid direct comparison; otherwise collect the declared final comparison, within the repeat/validity policy. If evidence cannot be validly completed, report unavailable.

persistence_authorization: This prompt explicitly permits completed-task result closure archive and validated cleanup; never clean failed/uncompleted tasks or old experiments.
binding_rule: Outer campaign policy only. Map supported fields to actual strict contracts; never inject this whole policy or unsupported fields into runtime schemas.
calibration_status: Uncalibrated targets inherited for continuity, not a claim that two rounds or runtime0.5.0 has measured these costs.
